name: Honda George
source:
Honda George is a member of the school's boxing club. He is also a member of the Glittering Star's "Filament" Squad. He goes by the name Raging Bull and his Cybody, Alephist, resembles a bull. He was the first opponent to face and be defeated by Takuto's Tauburn. [spoiler]At the end of the anime, he acquires his true mark and helps [url=/c80912]Takuto[/url].[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Star_Driver_characters##Glittering_Crux_Brigade]Wikipedia[/url].]
